   144→## Code Architecture
   145→
   146→### Video Player Architecture (`working_protos/00_video_loop*`)
   147→
   148→Optimized MJPEG player variants with minimal code footprint.
   149→
   150→**Design Pattern:**
   151→- **MemoryStream class**: Minimal Stream implementation for PSRAM buffer access
   152→- **VideoPlayer class**: Encapsulates display, flash I/O, and MJPEG decoding
   153→- **Singleton pattern**: Static instance for JPEG callback access
   154→- **RAII initialization**: All setup in `begin()`, simple `play()` for loop
   155→
   156→**Variants:**
   157→- `00_video_loop/` - Base video loop
   158→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause/` - Button pause/resume
   159→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause_gyro_rotate/` - IMU-based orientation
   160→
   161→### LLM Inference Architecture (`working_protos/01_llm_inference*`)
   162→
   163→Port of llama2.c for on-device text generation.
   164→
   165→**Files:**
   166→- `llm_core.cpp/h` - Transformer forward pass, attention, RoPE
   167→- `tokenizer.cpp/h` - BPE tokenizer (SentencePiece format)
   168→- `sampler.cpp/h` - Temperature/top-p sampling
   169→- `sd_data/` - Model and tokenizer binaries for SD card
   170→
   171→**Model Specs:**
   172→- `stories15m` - 15M param TinyStories (~15MB)
   173→- `stories260k` - 260K param TinyStories (~300KB, faster)
   174→
   175→**Usage:** Load model from SD card to PSRAM, generate token-by-token.
   176→
   177→### Wake Word Detection (`tests/wakeword_pretrained_test/`)
   178→
   179→microWakeWord-based detection using EdgeNeuron TFLite runtime.
   180→
   181→**Pipeline:**
   182→1. INMP441 mic → 16kHz audio capture
   183→2. Microfrontend → 40-bin log-mel spectrogram (30ms window, 10ms stride)
   184→3. EdgeNeuron → TFLite inference every 10ms
   185→4. Sliding window → Probability averaging → Detection trigger
   186→
   187→**Configuration:** JSON config on SD card controls thresholds:
   188→```json
   189→{"probability_cutoff": 0.5, "sliding_window_average_size": 10, ...}
   190→```
   191→
   192→**Training:** See `tests/wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` for custom wake word training via Colab.
   193→
   194→### Audio Embedding Architecture (`tests/yamnet_audio_embedding_ipynb_poc/`)
   195→
   196→YAMNet-based 1024-D audio embeddings on ESP32-S3.
   197→
   198→**Pipeline:**
   199→1. Dual INMP441 mics → stereo capture → mono downmix
   200→2. ESP-DSP accelerated FFT → 64-mel × 96-frame spectrogram
   201→3. TensorFlowLite_ESP32 → YAMNet inference (dual-core optimized)
   202→4. Extract 1024-D embedding → JSON output
   203→
   204→**Performance:** ~10-14 seconds total (inference is the bottleneck at 6-10s).
   205→
   206→### Factory Demo Architecture (`ESP32-S3-LCD-2-Demo/Arduino/examples/01_factory`)
   207→
   208→Multi-module reference implementation showing full hardware capabilities.
   209→
   210→**BSP Layer (Board Support Package):**
   211→- `bsp_spi.h/.cpp`: Shared SPI bus with semaphore protection
   212→- `bsp_i2c.h/.cpp`: I2C bus for IMU
   213→- `bsp_lv_port.h/.cpp`: LVGL display driver integration
   214→- `bsp_button.h/.cpp`: Hardware button handling
   215→
   216→**App Layer:**
   217→- `app_qmi8658`: IMU data reading and visualization
   218→- `app_system`: System monitoring (battery, brightness)
   219→- `app_camera`: Camera integration
   220→- `app_wifi`: WiFi scanning and connection
   221→
   222→**UI Layer:**
   223→- `lvgl_ui/`: LVGL tabview UI
   224→- Each tab corresponds to an app module
   225→
   226→**Initialization Sequence:**
   227→```cpp
   228→setup() {
   229→  bsp_i2c_init();      // I2C bus
   230→  bsp_lv_port_init();  // Display + LVGL
   231→  bsp_spi_init();      // Shared SPI
   232→  bsp_button_init();   // Buttons
   233→
   234→  lvgl_ui_init();      // UI components
   235→
   236→  app_*_init();        // Module initialization
   237→  app_*_run();         // Start module tasks
   238→}
   239→```
   240→
   241→### Key Libraries
   242→
   243→**Arduino_GFX_Library:**
   244→- Hardware abstraction for ST7789 display
   245→- SPI bus configuration: `Arduino_ESP32SPI`
   246→- Display driver: `Arduino_ST7789` (240x320, IPS mode)
   247→
   248→**LVGL (Light and Versatile Graphics Library):**
   249→- Must configure `lv_conf.h` before use
   250→- Factory example uses LVGL 8.x API
   251→- Thread safety via `lvgl_lock()`/`lvgl_unlock()`
   252→
   253→**JPEGDEC:**
   254→- Software JPEG decoder
   255→- Used by MjpegClass for frame-by-frame decoding
   256→- Callback-based rendering: `JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK`
   257→
   258→**MjpegClass:**
   259→- Custom MJPEG container parser (not a library)
   260→- Searches for JPEG markers (0xFFD8/0xFFD9) in stream
   261→- Extracts individual frames for JPEGDEC

   263→## FFat Partition Layout
   264→
   265→From `app3M_fat9M_16MB.csv`:
   266→```
   267→# Name,   Type, SubType, Offset,  Size
   268→nvs,      data, nvs,     0x9000,  0x5000
   269→otadata,  data, ota,     0xe000,  0x2000
   270→app0,     app,  ota_0,   0x10000, 0x300000
   271→app1,     app,  ota_1,   0x310000,0x300000
   272→ffat,     data, fat,     0x610000,0x9E0000
   273→```
   274→
   275→**Important:** Flash FFat images at offset **0x611000** (+0x1000 from partition start)
   276→
   277→## PSRAM Usage
   278→
   279→**Enabled via Arduino IDE settings:** OPI PSRAM
   280→
   281→**Allocation:**
   282→```cpp
   283→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(size);  // PSRAM
   284→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)malloc(size);     // Heap
   285→```
   286→
   287→**Best Practice:**
   288→- Large buffers (>100KB): Use PSRAM
   289→- Frame buffers, video data: PSRAM
   290→- Small work buffers: Heap
   291→
   292→## Common Patterns
   293→
   294→### Dual I2S Audio Architecture
   295→
   296→ESP32-S3 supports separate I2S buses for simultaneous input/output:
   297→
   298→```cpp
   299→// I2S0 for microphones (RX)
   300→i2s_config_t mic_config = {
   301→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX,
   302→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   303→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_32BIT,  // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame
   304→  .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_RIGHT_LEFT,
   305→  // ...
   306→};
   307→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &mic_config, 0, NULL);
   308→
   309→// I2S1 for speaker (TX)
   310→i2s_config_t spk_config = {
   311→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX,
   312→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   313→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_16BIT,
   314→  // ...
   315→};
   316→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_1, &spk_config, 0, NULL);
   317→```
   318→
   319→See `workbench/working_protos/02_speaker_mic_combo/` for full duplex example.
   320→
   321→### SPI Bus Sharing
   322→
   323→Multiple devices (LCD, SD card) share SPI bus - must use semaphore:
   324→
   325→```cpp
   326→if (bsp_spi_lock(-1)) {
   327→  // SPI operations
   328→  bsp_spi_unlock();
   329→}
   330→```
   331→
   332→### LVGL Thread Safety
   333→
   334→All LVGL calls must be protected:
   335→
   336→```cpp
   337→if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   338→  // LVGL UI updates
   339→  lvgl_unlock();
   340→}
   341→```
   342→
   343→### Stream-based File I/O
   344→
   345→Prefer Stream abstraction for memory/file interchangeability:
   346→
   347→```cpp
   348→class MemoryStream : public Stream {
   349→  // Implement available(), read(), peek(), readBytes()
   350→};
   351→```
   352→
   353→## Optimization Philosophy
   354→
   355→The `video_loop` prototype demonstrates aggressive optimization:
   356→
   357→**Removed:**
   358→- All Serial.print() debug output
   359→- Verbose error screens
   360→- Statistics tracking
   361→- Redundant comments and temporary variables
   362→
   363→**Retained:**
   364→- All functionality
   365→- Error detection (via return values)
   366→- Minimal LED feedback for critical failures
   367→
   368→**Result:** 59% code reduction (250→103 lines) with zero performance impact
   369→
   370→When modifying code, prioritize:
   371→1. Encapsulation over globals
   372→2. Classes over procedural code
   373→3. Minimal interfaces (begin/run pattern)
   374→4. Fail-fast error handling
   375→5. Production code = no debug spam
   376→
   377→## GPIO Pin Availability
   378→
   379→Based on ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2 schematic **PinOut** section:
   380→
   381→**Pins broken out to headers:**
   382→- IO2, IO4, IO6-18, IO21, IO43, IO44, IO47, IO48
   383→
   384→**Truly free pins** (no peripherals attached):
   385→- **GPIO 18** - Completely free
   386→- **GPIO 2, 4, 6-17, 21** - Camera pins (safe if camera not attached)
   387→
   388→**Occupied pins:**
   389→- GPIO 0 (BOOT), 1 (BL), 5 (BAT) - System
   390→- GPIO 19, 20 - USB D-, D+ (**not available**)
   391→- GPIO 33-37 - **NOT broken out** to headers
   392→- GPIO 38-42, 45 - SPI (LCD/SD card)
   393→- GPIO 43, 44 - Serial console (U0_TXD/RXD)
   394→- GPIO 46 - Touch panel interrupt
   395→- GPIO 47, 48 - I2C (IMU and touch panel)
   396→
   397→## Audio Hardware
   398→
   399→### Microphone (INMP441)
   400→- **Pins:** GPIO 2 (BCK), 4 (WS), 18 (DIN)
   401→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_0 (RX mode)
   402→- **Config:** Stereo capable, 24-bit samples, 16kHz sample rate
   403→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/mic_pin_test/` or `workbench/single_mic_test/`
   404→
   405→### Speaker (MAX98357A)
   406→- **Pins:** GPIO 6 (BCLK), 7 (LRC), 8 (DIN)
   407→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_1 (TX mode)
   408→- **Power:** 5V recommended for full power (3-5W capable)
   409→- **Config:** 16-bit samples, 44.1kHz sample rate, mono/stereo
   410→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/tests/speaker_beep_test/`
   411→- **Note:** GAIN pin controls volume (Float=9dB, GND=12dB, VDD=15dB)
   412→
   413→## ML Model Deployment
   414→
   415→### SD Card Layout for Models
   416→```
   417→SD:/
   418→├── models/
   419→│   ├── hey_daisy.tflite     # Wake word model (~130KB)
   420→│   └── hey_daisy.json       # Detection config
   421→├── yamnet.tflite            # Audio embedding model (167KB-4MB)

   426→### TensorFlow Lite Libraries
   427→- **EdgeNeuron**: Lightweight, good for small streaming models (wake word)
   428→- **TensorFlowLite_ESP32**: Full-featured, needed for larger models (YAMNet)
   429→
   430→### Colab Training Pipelines
   431→- `audio_semantic_xtts_ipynb/` - Audio semantic embeddings with XTTS-v2
   432→- `llm_qa_scaled_training/` - LLM Q&A fine-tuning with phases
   433→- `wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` - Custom wake word training

   435→## OAISYS Badge Implementation Phases
   436→
   437→The unified `oaisys_badge` firmware is built in 8 phases. See `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current progress.
   438→
   439→| Phase | Description | Key Files |
   440→|-------|-------------|-----------|
   441→| 1 | Core (Video + Button + Text) | `video_player.cpp`, `orientation.cpp` |
   442→| 2 | Wake Word + Recording | `wake_word.cpp`, `audio_recorder.cpp` |
   443→| 3 | Embedding + Similarity | `yamnet_embed.cpp`, `embed_search.cpp` |
   444→| 4 | LLM Integration | `llm_core.cpp`, `tokenizer.cpp` |
   445→| 5 | Robotic TTS (SAM) | `robot_tts.cpp` |
   446→| 6 | Deep Sleep + Wake | `sleep_manager.cpp` |
   447→| 7 | WiFi + Model Updates | `wifi_manager.cpp`, `model_updater.cpp` |
   448→| 8 | Stash Upload | `stash_manager.cpp`, `data_uploader.cpp` |
   449→| Backend | FastAPI + Redis | `main.py`, `workers.py` |
   450→
   451→### State Machine Flow
   452→```
   453→BOOT → LOGO_LOOP ←→ DEEP_SLEEP (5min idle)
   454→         ↓ (button/wake word)
   455→      RECORDING (3-5 sec)
   456→         ↓
   457→      EMBEDDING → SIMILARITY
   458→         ↓
   459→   score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → DISPLAY → TTS → LOGO_LOOP
   460→   score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → STASH_DATA → LOGO_LOOP
   461→```
   462→
   463→### Memory Management
   464→- Only ONE ML model loaded at a time
   465→- 6MB memory pool in PSRAM for model swapping
   466→- Load/unload via `begin()`/`end()` pattern
   467→
   468→### Working Methodology
   469→1. Check `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current phase
   470→2. Reference original prototypes in `working_protos/0X_*` for implementation patterns
   471→3. Update TODO tracker after completing each task
   472→4. Test each phase before moving to next

   135→### 1.3 Memory Management Strategy
   136→
   137→**Problem**: PSRAM is ~8MB, but models compete for space:
   138→- Wake word: ~700KB
   139→- YAMNet + projection: ~1MB
   140→- LLM: ~6MB
   141→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   142→
   143→**Solution**: Sequential model loading with explicit unload
   144→
   145→```cpp
   146→// Memory pool reserved in PSRAM
   147→#define ML_POOL_SIZE (6 * 1024 * 1024)  // 6MB for largest model
   148→static uint8_t* ml_pool = nullptr;
   149→
   150→// Each ML module uses pool, not direct ps_malloc
   151→class MLModule {
   152→public:
   153→    virtual bool load(uint8_t* pool, size_t pool_size) = 0;
   154→    virtual void unload() = 0;
   155→    virtual size_t requiredMemory() = 0;
   156→};
   157→
   158→// State transitions trigger load/unload:
   159→// LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   160→// RECORDING: wake_word.unload()
   161→// EMBEDDING: yamnet.load() → yamnet.unload()
   162→// LLM_INFER: llm.load() → llm.unload()
   163→// Return to LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   164→```
   165→
   166→### 1.4 Module Interfaces
   167→
   168→Each module follows `begin()`/`end()` pattern:
   169→
   170→```cpp
   171→// video_player.h
   172→class VideoPlayer {
   173→public:
   174→    bool begin(const char* mjpeg_path);  // Load video to PSRAM

   183→
   184→// wake_word.h
   185→class WakeWordDetector {
   186→public:

   188→    bool detect();       // Returns true on wake word
   189→    void end();          // Free all memory
   190→};
   191→
   192→// yamnet_embed.h
   193→class YamnetEmbedder {
   194→public:

   196→    bool extract(int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* embedding_out);
   197→    void end();
   198→};
   199→
   200→// llm_core.h (already exists, minor adaptations)
   201→class LLMInference {
   202→public:

   204→    void generate(const char* prompt, void (*on_token)(const char*));

   207→
   208→// robot_tts.h

   344→### 2.1 Architecture

   349→│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐  │
   350→│  │   FastAPI   │  │    Redis    │  │   File Storage     │  │

   510→### 4.1 Text Overlay on Video (LVGL)

   512→**Chosen: LVGL Overlay** - Rich typography, word wrap, polished look

   514→```cpp
   515→// text_overlay.cpp
   516→#include <lvgl.h>
   517→
   518→static lv_obj_t* text_layer = nullptr;
   519→static lv_obj_t* label = nullptr;
   520→
   521→void initTextOverlay() {
   522→    // Create semi-transparent container
   523→    text_layer = lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
   524→    lv_obj_set_size(text_layer, 230, 120);
   525→    lv_obj_align(text_layer, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -10);
   526→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(text_layer, LV_OPA_80, 0);
   527→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x001100), 0);
   528→    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(text_layer, 2, 0);
   529→    lv_obj_set_style_border_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);
   530→    lv_obj_set_style_radius(text_layer, 8, 0);
   531→
   532→    // Create label with retro monospace font
   533→    label = lv_label_create(text_layer);
   534→    lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_WRAP);
   535→    lv_obj_set_width(label, 210);
   536→    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);  // Matrix green
   537→    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
   538→    lv_obj_center(label);
   539→
   540→    // Initially hidden
   541→    lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   542→}
   543→
   544→void showText(const char* text) {
   545→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   546→        lv_label_set_text(label, text);
   547→        lv_obj_clear_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   548→        lvgl_unlock();
   549→    }
   550→}
   551→
   552→void hideText() {
   553→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   554→        lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   555→        lvgl_unlock();
   556→    }
   557→}
   558→
   559→// For streaming LLM output character-by-character
   560→void appendText(const char* chunk) {
   561→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   562→        const char* current = lv_label_get_text(label);
   563→        String updated = String(current) + chunk;
   564→        lv_label_set_text(label, updated.c_str());
   565→        lvgl_unlock();
   566→    }
   567→}
   568→```

   570→### 4.2 Wake Word → Recording Transition
   571→
   572→```cpp
   573→void transitionToRecording() {
   574→    // 1. Stop wake word detection
   575→    wakeWord.end();  // Frees ~700KB PSRAM
   576→
   577→    // 2. Reconfigure I2S for recording (same pins, different buffer size)
   578→    recorder.begin(RECORD_DURATION_MS);
   579→
   580→    // 3. Visual feedback
   581→    video.showText("Listening...");
   582→
   583→    // 4. Record
   584→    int16_t* audio = recorder.record();  // Blocking, returns PSRAM buffer
   585→    size_t samples = recorder.getSampleCount();
   586→
   587→    // 5. Save to SD
   588→    saveAudioToSD(audio, samples);
   589→
   590→    // 6. Transition to embedding
   591→    transitionToEmbedding(audio, samples);
   592→}
   593→```
   594→
   595→### 4.3 Cosine Similarity Search
   596→
   597→```cpp
   598→// embed_search.cpp
   599→class EmbeddingSearch {
   600→    float* embeddings;      // 300 × 256 floats from SD
   601→    char** intents;         // 300 strings from SD
   602→    int count;
   603→
   604→public:
   605→    bool begin(const char* embed_path, const char* intent_path) {
   606→        // Load embeddings.bin (307KB) to PSRAM
   607→        embeddings = (float*)ps_malloc(300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   608→        File f = SD.open(embed_path);
   609→        f.read((uint8_t*)embeddings, 300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   610→
   611→        // Load intents.txt (one per line)
   612→        // ...
   613→    }
   614→
   615→    SearchResult search(float* query_embed) {
   616→        float best_score = -1;
   617→        int best_idx = -1;
   618→
   619→        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   620→            float score = cosineSimilarity(query_embed, &embeddings[i * 256], 256);
   621→            if (score > best_score) {
   622→                best_score = score;
   623→                best_idx = i;
   624→            }
   625→        }
   626→
   627→        return {intents[best_idx], best_score};
   628→    }
   629→
   630→private:
   631→    float cosineSimilarity(float* a, float* b, int len) {
   632→        float dot = 0, norm_a = 0, norm_b = 0;
   633→        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   634→            dot += a[i] * b[i];
   635→            norm_a += a[i] * a[i];
   636→            norm_b += b[i] * b[i];
   637→        }
   638→        return dot / (sqrtf(norm_a) * sqrtf(norm_b));
   639→    }
   640→};
   641→```
   642→
   643→### 4.4 Robotic TTS with SAM (Software Automatic Mouth)
   644→
   645→**Chosen: SAM** - Any text input, classic 1980s computer voice
   646→
   647→SAM is the legendary Commodore 64 / Apple II speech synthesizer. It converts
   648→arbitrary English text to phonemes and synthesizes robotic speech. Perfect for
   649→that retro "talking computer" vibe!
   650→
   651→```cpp
   652→// robot_tts.cpp
   653→// Using ESP32-SAM port: https://github.com/pschatzmann/ESP32-SAM
   654→
   655→#include "ESP32SAM.h"
   656→#include "AudioOutputI2S.h"
   657→
   658→class RobotTTS {
   659→private:
   660→    AudioOutputI2S* out = nullptr;
   661→    ESP32SAM* sam = nullptr;
   662→
   663→public:
   664→    bool begin() {
   665→        // Configure I2S for MAX98357A speaker
   666→        out = new AudioOutputI2S();
   667→        out->SetPinout(6, 7, 8);  // BCLK, LRC, DOUT
   668→        out->SetGain(0.5);        // Volume control
   669→        out->begin();
   670→
   671→        sam = new ESP32SAM();
   672→        return true;
   673→    }
   674→
   675→    void speak(const char* text) {
   676→        // SAM handles text-to-phoneme conversion internally
   677→        // Output: 22050Hz mono audio
   678→        sam->Say(out, text);
   679→    }
   680→
   681→    // For more robotic effect, adjust voice parameters
   682→    void setRoboticVoice() {
   683→        sam->SetSpeed(72);      // Default 72, lower = slower
   684→        sam->SetPitch(64);      // Default 64, higher = squeakier
   685→        sam->SetThroat(128);    // Default 128, affects resonance
   686→        sam->SetMouth(128);     // Default 128, affects articulation
   687→    }
   688→
   689→    // Ultra robotic: pitch down, slow, mechanical
   690→    void setUltraRobotic() {
   691→        sam->SetSpeed(50);      // Slow and deliberate
   692→        sam->SetPitch(40);      // Deep, mechanical
   693→        sam->SetThroat(160);    // More robotic resonance
   694→        sam->SetMouth(100);     // Slightly muffled
   695→    }
   696→
   697→    void end() {
   698→        if (sam) { delete sam; sam = nullptr; }
   699→        if (out) { delete out; out = nullptr; }
   700→    }
   701→};
   702→
   703→// Usage in main sketch:
   704→RobotTTS tts;
   705→
   706→void setup() {
   707→    tts.begin();
   708→    tts.setUltraRobotic();  // Maximum robot vibes!
   709→}
   710→
   711→void speakResponse(const char* text) {
   712→    video.showText(text);      // Show on screen
   713→    tts.speak(text);           // Speak robotically
   714→    delay(2000);               // Pause after speaking
   715→    video.hideText();          // Resume logo
   716→}
   717→```
   718→
   719→**Memory footprint**: ~50KB ROM for SAM phoneme tables
   720→**Latency**: Near-instant start (no model loading)
   721→**Quality**: Authentic 1980s computer voice - perfect for badge aesthetic!
   722→
   723→### 4.5 Deep Sleep with Accelerometer Wake
   724→
   725→```cpp
   726→// sleep_manager.cpp
   727→#include "esp_sleep.h"
   728→#include "driver/rtc_io.h"
   729→
   730→#define ACCEL_INT_PIN GPIO_NUM_XX  // QMI8658 INT pin (check schematic)
   731→
   732→void enterDeepSleep() {
   733→    // Save state to RTC memory
   734→    RTC_DATA_ATTR static uint8_t last_rotation;
   735→    last_rotation = video.getRotation();
   736→
   737→    // Configure QMI8658 motion interrupt
   738→    // (Set high-g threshold, enable interrupt output)
   739→    configureAccelInterrupt();
   740→
   741→    // Configure wake source
   742→    esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup(ACCEL_INT_PIN, 1);  // Wake on HIGH
   743→
   744→    // Enter deep sleep
   745→    esp_deep_sleep_start();
   746→}
   747→
   748→void setup() {
   749→    if (esp_sleep_get_wakeup_cause() == ESP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_EXT0) {
   750→        // Woke from shake - restore state
   751→        video.setRotation(last_rotation);
   752→    }
   753→    // Normal boot...
   754→}
   755→```
   756→
   757→---
   758→
   759→## Part 5: Testing Checkpoints
   760→
   761→| Phase | Test | Pass Criteria |
   762→|-------|------|---------------|
   763→| 1 | Logo plays | MJPEG loops smoothly at 30+ FPS |
   764→| 1 | Text overlay | Text appears over video |
   765→| 1 | Gyro rotation | Tilting rotates display |
   766→| 2 | Wake word | "Hey Daisy" triggers within 2 sec |
   767→| 2 | Recording | 5 sec audio saved to SD as WAV |
   768→| 3 | Embedding | YAMNet produces 256-dim vector |
   769→| 3 | Similarity | Correct intent found for test phrase |
   770→| 4 | LLM load | Model loads in <5 sec |
   771→| 4 | Generation | Response streams to display |
   772→| 5 | TTS output | Robotic speech audible from speaker |
   773→| 6 | Deep sleep | Current drops to <10mA |
   774→| 6 | Shake wake | Badge wakes and resumes logo |
   775→| 7 | WiFi connect | Connects from SD config |
   776→| 7 | Model check | Detects new version on server |
   777→| 8 | Stash upload | 10 files uploaded successfully |
   778→| Backend | Manifest | GET returns model versions |
   779→| Backend | Transcribe | Uploaded audio gets transcript |
   780→| Backend | Correction | UI allows editing and saving |
   781→
   782→---
   783→
   784→## Part 6: Risk Mitigation
   785→
   786→| Risk | Mitigation |
   787→|------|------------|
   788→| PSRAM fragmentation | Use fixed memory pool, sequential load/unload |
   789→| Wake word false positives | Tune threshold in config.json, add cooldown |
   790→| Embedding mismatch | Start with high threshold (0.8), tune down |
   791→| LLM hallucination | Train on exact Q&A, use low temperature |
   792→| TTS unintelligible | Test Talkie vs SAM, choose clearer one |
   793→| WiFi unreliable | Graceful degradation, work fully offline |
   794→| Deep sleep instability | Test thoroughly, add watchdog timer |
   795→| SD card corruption | Use safe write patterns, checksums |
   796→
   797→---
   798→
   799→## Implementation Order (Sequential)
   800→
   801→**Chosen approach**: Complete each phase before starting next - safer, easier to debug
   802→
   803→```
   804→Week 1: Foundation
   805→├── Phase 1: Core (Video + State Machine)              ████████░░  2-3 days
   806→│   └── Checkpoint: Logo plays, gyro rotates, text overlay works
   807→│
   808→└── Phase 2: Wake Word + Recording                     ████████░░  2 days
   809→    └── Checkpoint: "Hey Daisy" triggers, 5 sec recorded to SD
   810→
   811→Week 2: ML Pipeline
   812→├── Phase 3: Embedding Extraction                      ████████░░  2-3 days
   813→│   └── Checkpoint: Audio → 256-dim embedding → similarity search
   814→│
   815→└── Phase 4: LLM Integration                           ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   816→    └── Checkpoint: Matched intent → LLM generates → displays text
   817→
   818→Week 3: Audio + Power
   819→├── Phase 5: Robotic TTS (SAM)                         ████████░░  2-3 days
   820→│   └── Checkpoint: Badge speaks responses in robotic voice
   821→│
   822→└── Phase 6: Deep Sleep + Wake                         ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   823→    └── Checkpoint: 5min idle → sleep → shake → wake
   824→
   825→Week 4: Network + Backend
   826→├── Phase 7: WiFi + Model Updates                      ████████░░  2 days
   827→│   └── Checkpoint: Downloads new model from server
   828→│
   829→├── Phase 8: Stash Upload                              ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   830→│   └── Checkpoint: Uploads 10 unrecognized audio files
   831→│
   832→└── Backend: FastAPI + Redis + Correction UI           ████████████  3-4 days
   833→    └── Checkpoint: Full cloud pipeline working
   834→```
   835→
   836→**Total: ~4 weeks** sequential implementation

     1→# OAISYS25 Badge Firmware
     2→
     3→Unified firmware integrating all badge functionality.
     4→
     5→> **Plan:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_PLAN.md`
     6→> **Progress:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md`
     7→
     8→## Phase 2: Wake Word + Recording (Current)
     9→- Video loop playback (MJPEG from SD card)
    10→- Gyro-based screen rotation
    11→- Wake word detection ("Hey Daisy")
    12→- Audio recording after wake word trigger
    13→
    14→## Hardware
    15→- ESP32-S3-LCD-2 (Waveshare)
    16→- ST7789 240x320 LCD
    17→- QMI8658 IMU
    18→- INMP441 Mics (x2)
    19→- MAX98357A Speaker
    20→- SD Card (for media, models, config)
    21→
    22→## Building
    23→1. Open `oaisys_badge.ino` in Arduino IDE 2.x
    24→2. Select Board: ESP32S3 Dev Module
    25→3. Settings:
    26→   - Flash: 16MB
    27→   - Partition: 16MB Flash (3MB APP/9MB FATFS)
    28→   - PSRAM: OPI PSRAM
    29→4. Upload sketch
    30→5. Copy `sd_data/*` contents to SD card root
    31→
    32→## Controls (Phase 2)
    33→- **Wake word**: Say "Hey Daisy" to start recording
    34→- Recording shows RED screen, completion shows GREEN
    35→- Auto-returns to video loop after 2 seconds
    36→
    37→## Directory Structure
    38→```
    39→oaisys_badge/
    40→├── oaisys_badge.ino    # Main sketch
    41→├── config.h            # Pin definitions
    42→├── src/                # Source files (Arduino compiles recursively)
    43→│   ├── display/
    44→│   │   └── video_player.*  # Video + text overlay
    45→│   ├── sensors/
    46→│   │   └── orientation.*   # IMU rotation
    47→│   ├── audio/              # (Phase 2)
    48→│   ├── ml/                 # (Phase 3-4)
    49→│   ├── tts/                # (Phase 5)

    84→
    85→**Arduino Sketch Rule:** `.ino` file MUST be in folder with same name (e.g., `my_sketch/my_sketch.ino`)
    86→
    87→## Code Architecture
    88→
    89→### State Machine (`local_llm_badge/local_llm_badge.ino`)
    90→
    91→The main firmware implements this flow:
    92→```
    93→BOOT → LOGO_LOOP ←→ DEEP_SLEEP (5min idle)
    94→         ↓ (wake word: "Hey Daisy")
    95→      RECORDING (3-5 sec, RED screen)
    96→         ↓
    97→      EMBEDDING → SIMILARITY
    98→         ↓
    99→   score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → DISPLAY → TTS → LOGO_LOOP
   100→   score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → STASH_DATA → LOGO_LOOP
   101→```
   102→
   103→### Module Pattern
   104→
   105→All modules follow `begin()`/`end()` with memory pool for sequential model loading:
   106→```cpp
   107→class MLModule {
   108→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t size);  // Load to shared 6MB pool
   109→    void end();                               // Free for next model
   110→};
   111→```
   112→
   113→### Key Implementations
   114→
   115→| Component | Location | Pattern |
   116→|-----------|----------|---------|
   117→| Video Player | `src/display/video_player.*` | MemoryStream + JPEGDEC callback |
   118→| Wake Word | `src/ml/wake_word.*` | EdgeNeuron + sliding window |
   119→| Audio Embed | `src/ml/audio_embed.*` | ESP-DSP FFT + TFLite CNN |
   120→| LLM | `src/ml/llm_core.*` | llama2.c port, Q8_0 quantized |
   121→| TTS | `src/tts/robot_tts.*` | ESP32-SAM at 22050Hz |
   122→| Orientation | `src/sensors/orientation.*` | QMI8658 via FastIMU |
   123→
   124→### Reference Prototypes
   125→
   126→Working examples in `workbench/working_protos/`:
   127→- `00_video_loop*` - MJPEG playback variants
   128→- `01_llm_inference*` - LLM text generation
   129→- `02_speaker_mic_combo` - Dual I2S audio
   130→- `03_custom_wakeword` - Wake word detection
   131→- `04_yamnet_audio_embedding` - Audio embeddings
   132→- `05_llm_finetuned` - Fine-tuned Q8_0 LLM
   133→
   134→## Memory & Partitions
   135→
   136→### PSRAM Budget (~8MB)
   137→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   138→- ML Pool: 6MB (shared, one model at a time)
   139→- Embedding DB: ~300KB
   140→
   141→### FFat Partition (16MB Flash)
   142→```
   143→Offset     Size       Name
   144→0x610000   0x9E0000   ffat (9.9MB)
   145→```
   146→**Flash at 0x611000** (+0x1000 from partition start)
   147→
   148→## Common Patterns
   149→
   150→### Dual I2S Audio
   151→```cpp
   152→// I2S0: Microphones (RX), 16kHz, 32-bit (INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame)
   153→// I2S1: Speaker (TX), 22050Hz for SAM TTS
   154→```
   155→
   156→### SPI Bus Sharing (LCD + SD)
   157→```cpp
   158→// Use semaphore when shared: bsp_spi_lock(-1) / bsp_spi_unlock()
   159→```
   160→
   161→### PSRAM Allocation
   162→```cpp
   163→ps_malloc(size);   // Large buffers (>100KB)
   164→malloc(size);      // Small work buffers
   165→```
   166→
   167→## SD Card Layout
   168→```
   169→SD:/
   170→├── config.json              # Runtime config (WiFi, thresholds)
   171→├── media/logo.mjpeg         # Boot animation
   172→├── models/
   173→│   ├── wake_word.tflite     # 130KB
   174→│   ├── audio_encoder.tflite # 100-300KB (custom CNN)
   175→│   ├── llm_model.bin        # 6MB (Q8_0)
   176→│   └── tokenizer.bin        # 13KB
   177→└── data/
   178→    ├── embeddings.bin       # 300×256 float32
   179→    └── intents.txt          # Intent strings
   180→```
   181→
   182→## Implementation Progress
   183→
   184→See `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current status.
   185→
   186→| Phase | Status |
   187→|-------|--------|
   188→| 1: Video + Gyro | COMPLETE |
   189→| 2: Wake Word | COMPLETE |
   190→| 3: Embedding | IN PROGRESS (training) |
   191→| 4: LLM | COMPLETE |
   192→| 5: TTS (SAM) | COMPLETE |
   193→| 6-8: Sleep/WiFi/Stash | PENDING |
   194→
   195→## Design Principles
   196→
   197→1. **Single model in memory** - Sequential load/unload to 6MB pool
   198→2. **No debug spam** - Production builds remove Serial.print()
   199→3. **Encapsulation** - Classes with begin()/end() pattern
   200→4. **Fail-fast** - Return values, minimal error screens
   201→5. **SD-first** - Models and config on SD card, not flash
   202→
